tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background in every theme. text-primary, text-secondary, interactive and every support-* text color pass on it.

tokens.name: layer
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows and dialogs, set on background. The same text pairs pass on it.

tokens.name: layer-alt
tokens.usage: Table headers and zebra rows. The same text pairs pass on it.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a dialog, and nothing else.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between rows and sections. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, secondary buttons and every control: 3:1 on background, layer and layer-alt in every theme. In high-contrast it also outlines every surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, 3:1 on background, layer and layer-alt in every theme.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and amounts on background, layer, layer-alt, brand-tint and every support-*-soft tint (4.5:1, and 7:1 in high-contrast).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Helper text, metadata, timestamps and the refunded status on background, layer and layer-alt.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only. WCAG exempts inactive controls, so this sits below 4.5:1 by design; never use it for information.

tokens.name: text-on-interactive
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on an interactive or interactive-hover fill, such as the primary button.

tokens.name: interactive
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links and selected states. As text it passes on background, layer and layer-alt.

tokens.name: interactive-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button, under text-on-interactive.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of interactive, so a theme that moves interactive moves links.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Deep brand blocks on the cover and the docs header. Never text, never a status.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand surface behind text-primary, such as a highlighted tip. Never a status.

tokens.name: support-success
tokens.usage: Final payments and passed checksums, as text or icon on background, layer and support-success-soft. It is teal, not green, so success never depends on telling red from green, and it always comes with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: support-success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind support-success or text-primary in a success notice.

tokens.name: support-warning
tokens.usage: Near-limit and new-address warnings, as text or icon on background, layer and support-warning-soft, always with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: support-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind support-warning or text-primary in a warning notice.

tokens.name: support-danger
tokens.usage: Failed payments, errors and over-limit states, as text or icon on background, layer and support-danger-soft, always with an X icon and a word. Never a brand or primary-button color.

tokens.name: support-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind support-danger or text-primary in an error notice.

tokens.name: support-info
tokens.usage: Submitted and confirming payments and neutral notices, as text or icon on background, layer and support-info-soft, always with a circle icon and a word.

tokens.name: support-info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind support-info or text-primary in an info notice.

tokens.name: network-test
tokens.usage: Fill of the test-network badge only. It marks test money and never means a transaction status.

tokens.name: text-on-network-test
tokens.usage: The label on a network-test fill.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the welcome screen and week titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Payments on a blockchain are final.
styles.usage: Explanations in weekly challenges and long-form help.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your agent paid Weather API 0.05 USDC.
styles.usage: Default text in the app: table cells, dialogs, notices.

styles.name: helper
styles.sample: You'll confirm before anything is sent.
styles.usage: Helper and error text under fields, in text-secondary or a support-* color.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: The one headline figure on the spending page. Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) and always with its unit.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in dialogs and summaries, with tabular figures and a unit.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Wallet addresses in groups of four, transaction hashes and code.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps only, such as an icon nudge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The base unit. Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside tags and between related controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Field padding, and the gap between label and input.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding on phones, and grid padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding on desktop, and the gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Space above a section title.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Space between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on the welcome screen.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: The largest gap, used on the cover and landing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes and table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and the cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status tags and badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only. Dark mode leans on layer instead, and high-contrast uses border-strong because shadows barely show there.

tokens.name: icon-16
tokens.usage: Icons inside tags and table cells, hand-tuned at this size.

tokens.name: icon-20
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and notices.

tokens.name: icon-24
tokens.usage: Standalone icons and empty states.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact buttons and inputs in tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones, and the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: duration-fast-01
tokens.usage: Micro-interactions: button press, toggle.

tokens.name: duration-fast-02
tokens.usage: Small fades, such as a tooltip.

tokens.name: duration-moderate-01
tokens.usage: Status changes, such as confirming to final.

tokens.name: duration-moderate-02
tokens.usage: Dialogs and panels opening. Nothing moves longer than this, and all motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Elements that move or change within the screen.

tokens.name: easing-entrance
tokens.usage: Elements entering, such as a dialog or a notice.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phones: 4 columns, the phone layout.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: 8 columns.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops: 16 columns, the desktop layout.

tokens.name: bp-xlg
tokens.usage: Wide screens: 16 columns.

tokens.name: bp-max
tokens.usage: Maximum layout width.
